title: Manager scratchpad: Avery -> Ravi (pre-1:1)
content:
Context / goals for this 1:1:
- Quick sync (30m). Priority: unblock Ravi, agree next steps on the mini-migrator, career growth check-in, and timeline for stacking quantization tests into CI.
- Tone: supportive, coaching. Bring data but avoid turning into a status readout.

Agenda (30m):
1) 5m — Relationship / mood check
   - How are you feeling about workload and team? Any low-energy items I should know about?
   - One sentence: wins / pain this week.
2) 8m — Blockers and decisions
   - Mini-migrator (wip): last checkpoint from infra sync — still blocked by the cluster auth issue. Ask: what specifically needs from me (ticket escalation, partner intro, timeline change)?
   - Quant test failures on nightly job (flaky on p99 mem). Which test cases are failing most? Any repro steps I should have?
3) 8m — Career / growth (short coaching)
   - Follow-up from last time: Ravi wanted to own a small architecture doc and present to arch-review next quarter. Quick status and obstacles.
   - Discuss visibility: possible demo at next all-hands (safe scope: demo mini-migrator in dev).
4) 6m — Roadmap alignment & next week priorities
   - Near-term: finish migrator auth shim OR cut a rollback plan. Agree on what "done" means this week.
   - Medium: start first pass of quantization perf profile for Llama-2 variant. Scope to a single benchmark.
5) 3m — Close / action items
   - Confirm owners and deadlines. Quick morale note.

Prep notes / facts to reference:
- Ticket INF-324: cluster auth negotiation — currently "in progress", blocked by external infra team for IAM policy change. Owner: Ravi. SLA request: need change within 48h to avoid rollout delay.
- PR #482: mini-migrator prototype branch — awaiting review; CI failing on macOS-lint only (non-blocking).
- Nightly quant-tests: failures spike on seed 42 and long-sequence scenarios (seq_len > 1536). Metric: p99 mem +12% compared to baseline.

Questions I want to ask Ravi directly:
- Where would you prioritize effort if we only had one engineer-week this sprint?
- What support do you need from me to remove the auth blocker? (do you want me to ping infra eng manager, draft escalation email, or join sync?)
- Are you still interested in owning the arch doc? If yes, what scope would make this feel achievable in 4 weeks?

Hypotheses / coaching prompts (for the career part):
- Ravi likes opaque systems work but oscillates when stakes feel customer-facing. Frame the migrator as a low-risk customer demo to increase confidence.
- He benefits from micro-goals and visible wins (1-2 demos, then doc). Suggest breaking arch doc into: outline -> 1st draft -> internal review -> arch-review slide.

Potential actions I can take this week (notes to self):
- If Ravi asks, I will: 1) escalate INF-324 via DM to Priya (infra manager) and cc SRE lead; 2) offer to sit on the auth sync; 3) draft rollback plan with him.
- If quant tests keep failing, propose a small experiment: run failing seeds with reduced batch size to isolate memory vs algorithmic issues. Ask research for assistance (cc: Mei Chen).
- Offer Ravi a short slot at next all-hands (5 min) if migrator demo is runnable in staging by EOW.

Draft action items (will capture during meeting):
- Ravi: reproduce auth failure and post exact IAM diff by 2026-07-20 (owner: Ravi Shah; due: 2026-07-20)
- Avery: DM Priya + SRE; offer to join sync if needed (owner: Avery Lee; due: 2026-07-19)
- Ravi: run quant test with reduced batch sizes and report p99 mem numbers (owner: Ravi Shah; due: 2026-07-22)
- Ravi + Avery: define minimal demo plan for migrator (owner: both; due: 2026-07-23)
- Ravi: prepare 1-page outline for arch doc (owner: Ravi Shah; due: 2026-08-05)

Notes to capture during 1:1 (placeholders):
- Mood check: ____
- Blocker details: ____
- Decision on escalate? yes/no
- Agreed minimal demo scope: ____

Follow-up cadence and reminders:
- I'll ping Ravi on Slack by EOD 2026-07-19 to confirm escalation outcome.
- Weekly sync: follow up on actions in next 1:1 (2026-07-25 tentative).

Quick binary check for me post-meeting:
- Did Ravi leave with clear next steps? (Y/N)
- Any interpersonal red flags? (Y/N + notes)
- Is there a manager-action requiring immediate exec-level escalation? (Y/N)

Loose ideas (scratch space) — not for meeting unless Ravi opens it:
- Small pilot: run migrator against a stale dev cluster snapshot to validate auth shim without touching prod. Could be a low-friction demo path.
- Reward: team pizza + shoutout if we get demo working in staging this week.

End of scratchpad.

(Will tidy and move action items to tracker after the 1:1; keep this doc as ephemeral, personal notes.)
